$description: Orrery roles: the names every brand fills. Color values come from the brand and its modes.

color.$description: Monochrome by design: no hue anywhere. A white page, two flat grey layers, one hairline. Accent equals text.

page.$description: Page background: the white ground every layer sits on. Also the ink on `text` fills (selected segment, solid chip) and on dark ramp steps; `on-accent` covers the primary button only.

layer-1.$description: First layer on the page: sheets, panels, index cards, the memo head, the rail. Pair with a `line-width` `line` border; elevation is fill plus hairline, not shadow.

layer-2.$description: Second layer: insets nested in a sheet, callouts, chips, inline code, segmented-control tracks, hover fill. Text on it is `text`, never `text-muted`.

line.$description: The hairline: `line-width` borders on layers, row dividers in lists and tables, the gaps between panel cells.

line-strong.$description: Heavy rule at `line-width`: under table headers, the border of a highlighted index card, the strong chip.

line-dashed.$description: Non-text strokes only: dashed borders for absent items and incidents. Too faint for text, so never set type in it.

text.$description: Primary text, headings, numerals, and the bold lede-in that leads a muted paragraph. Reads on `page`, `layer-1` and `layer-2` in both themes.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: support prose, meta lines, mono labels, table headers. Reads on `page` and `layer-1` only; on `layer-2` use `text`.

accent.$description: Used in exactly two roles: the focus ring and the primary button fill. Equals `text` in the default preset.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: the primary button.

scale-1.$description: Value ramp step 1 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-1-ink`. Outline it with an inset `line` ring on light grounds.

scale-2.$description: Value ramp step 2 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-2-ink`.

scale-3.$description: Value ramp step 3 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-3-ink`.

scale-4.$description: Value ramp step 4 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-4-ink`.

scale-5.$description: Value ramp step 5 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-5-ink`.

scale-1-ink.$description: Text on a `scale-1` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

scale-2-ink.$description: Text on a `scale-2` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

scale-3-ink.$description: Text on a `scale-3` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

scale-4-ink.$description: Text on a `scale-4` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

scale-5-ink.$description: Text on a `scale-5` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

title.$description: Page title (h1). Class `title`. Drops to 32px under 600px (bundle.css). Balanced wrap.

com.orrery.sample: Pick a direction before the build

lead.$description: The answer sentence. Class `lead`. Drops to 21px under 600px (bundle.css).

com.orrery.sample: Ship the rail page as the default; keep memo for one-answer notes.

heading.$description: Section heading (h2), every mode. Class `heading` on `.os-sh`.

subhead.$description: Row and card titles: decision questions, index answers, the memo head RE line. Class `subhead`.

com.orrery.sample: Which page mode is the default?

body.$description: Default prose. Put class `body` on `<body>`. Prose blocks cap at `layout-measure`.

com.orrery.sample: Every page answers first, then shows the decisions, then the evidence.

body-sm.$description: Secondary prose: decision rationale, sub-bullets, ledger rows, table cells. Class `body-sm`.

com.orrery.sample: Rail keeps the answer in view while the evidence scrolls.

caption.$description: Notes, ramp captions, panel-mode base size. Class `caption`.

com.orrery.sample: Ordinal data only; never a status color.

stat.$description: Tally numerals above a mono label. Class `stat`; tabular numerals. In panel mode use `title` for hero numbers.

label.$description: Mono data role only: table and tally headers, scale steps, row keys, the toc, chips. Never an eyebrow, kicker or section head. Class `label`; bundle.css adds uppercase and `text-muted`.

com.orrery.sample: Version · Shipped · Days to a fix

data.$description: Mono cells: dates, IDs, counts, first table column, kv values. Class `data`; tabular numerals.
